newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aussie Home says November was a record month.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aussie Home says November was a record month.

text.p: Mortgage originator Aussie Home Loans Ltd said on Monday it had achieved record monthly lending in November, with A$345 million allocated to home buyers.
The company said this was a 60 percent rise from October.
Aussie Home Loans, a low-cost operator which has taken market share from the banks in the last two years, said nearly half of November's loans were refinancing deals to bank customers.
Managing director John Symond said Aussie Home Loans had written more than A$1.3 billion of business in the past five months.
